item.title: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/FJTJBSI-Recalls-Six-Drawer-Dressers-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Tip-Over-and-Entrapment-Hazards-Violate-Mandatory-Standard-for-Clothing-Storage-Units
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from November 2024 through July 2026 for about $170.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from November 2024 through July 2026 for about $170.
item.summary: This recall involves the FJTJBSI-branded wood dressers. The black or white dressers measure about 15.1 inches long, 27.6 inches wide and 42.2 inches high, and weigh 68 pounds. The dressers have six drawers with silver or black handles. “LBS-XD-4-2-BLK-023” or “LBS-XD-4-2-WIT-024” is printed on a label on the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: FJTJBSI Six-drawer Dressers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact FJTJBSI for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “RECALLED” on the dresser and send a photo of the marked dresser to FJTJBSIrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
